decisions.reason: The award-winning organic yogurt variant fits the firm's dairy core and already had visible positive recognition, so management would likely continue it.
This newly promoted organic cheese was featured prominently on the home page, suggesting active support and a good fit with everyday German cheese consumption.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a standard product for a German dairy producer and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch without clear failure signals.
Spicy cheese is somewhat more niche than the core range, but it still complements the cheese portfolio and would usually get more time in market.
The mild creamy soft cheese broadened the offer in an accessible way, which makes it a plausible range extension worth retaining.
A washed-rind soft cheese serves a more specialized taste segment, but for a cheese-focused German producer it remains close enough to the core business to keep for now.
